River Canine Rehabilitation, located in Springfield, Missouri is the premiere rehabilitation facility for pets in the Southwest Missouri area.  Kara Amstutz, DVM, CCRT, CVPP is not only a certified rehab therapist, but also a certified pain practitioner for pets.  She and Linda MacDougall, CCRA work together to relieve pain, improve function, and build strength for pets. If your pet has suffered an injury, has had (or needs to have) surgery to repair back or joint injury (such as cruciate ligament injury or IVDD), suffers from osteoarthritis,  or is overweight and needs to get into shape - WE are the place for your pet! We also help working or agility dogs condition to increase endurance and cardiovascular health.  Don't forget cats - we help them too!

www.rivercaninerehab.com
2215-A  West  Republic Road
Springfield, MO 65807
417-883-7297
